title: SB0441 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-01-28; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513162233 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB0441.pdf (LegiScan doc 3086555))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2025-01-28 (as filed); crossfiled twin shares this text. Adds a new subdivision; deletes nothing. Summary says 'As introduced'.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1359(c)(3)): (3) This subsection (c) does not apply to a person who possesses or carries a firearm into an area where firearms are not permitted under this section if, upon the request of an individual authorized to control access to the property, the person immediately leaves the property or stores the firearm in a personal vehicle in accordance with § 39-17-1313.
